• Aṅguttara Nikāya 10.123 Numbered Discourses 10.123
  • 13. Parisuddhavagga 13. Purified

Paṭhamasutta First

“Dasayime, bhikkhave, dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā, nāññatra sugatavinayā. “Mendicants, these ten things are not purified and cleansed apart from the Holy One’s training. Katame dasa? What ten? Sammādiṭṭhi, sammāsaṅkappo, sammāvācā, sammākammanto, sammāājīvo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati, sammāsamādhi, sammāñāṇaṁ, sammāvimutti—Right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right immersion, right knowledge, and right freedom. ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā, nāññatra sugatavinayā”ti. These ten things are not purified and cleansed apart from the Holy One’s training.”

Paṭhamaṁ.
